current_evidence: Trafford's 'Validation requirements' page links the 'Planning Application Adopted Validation Checklist - January 2025' as the current checklist, and the document's cover says 'Adopted January 2025'. It follows the Citizen Space consultation that ran from 11 Nov to 23 Dec 2024, and no later revision was found.

issues.detail:
Many local requirements in the January 2025 checklist are missing from app_type_rows:
- Accommodation Schedule: residential development (Full, Outline, Reserved Matters, NMA).
- Accurate Visual Representations: proposals likely to significantly affect heritage assets or townscape/landscape. These appear only as stray text in the 'Pre-application advice' row.
- Air Quality Assessment – Ecology: development that may affect designated sites.
- Context Character Appraisal: new residential and non-residential development, excluding householder and some changes of use.
- Design Code Compliance Statement: new development excluding householder (Appendix 1 template).
- Digital Connectivity Statement: new buildings and changes of use (Full and Outline).
- Façade Design Analysis: new buildings excluding B2/B8 uses (Full, Outline where appearance is not reserved, and Reserved Matters).
- Green Belt Impact Statement: Full, Outline and Householder applications for demolition, extension or replacement of dwellings in the Green Belt, and all inappropriate development there.
- Green Infrastructure Statement: where Revised SPD1 requires it.
- Heat and Energy Network Assessment: 10+ dwellings or more than 1,000 sq m within Heat and Energy Network Opportunity Areas.
- Housing Needs Statement: 10+ dwellings, or 0.5 ha+ where numbers are unknown.
- Local Labour and Training Agreements: 10+ dwellings or 0.5 ha; non-residential 1,000 sq m+ or 1 ha+. These appear only as the tab fragment 'Work experience (14-16 years...'.
- Materials Schedule: all applications with new buildings or extensions, or new materials on existing buildings.
- Landscape/Townscape Visual Appraisal: buildings significantly taller than their neighbours, or sensitive sites.
- Parameter Plans: Outline applications.
- Peat survey: appears only as a 'Submission rules' tab item.
issues.evidence: Application Validation Checklist (Adopted January 2025), Local Information Requirements section, e.g. 'GREEN BELT IMPACT STATEMENT Threshold – Requirement for Full, Outline and Householder applications...'

issues.detail: Householder lists only the CIL form and the Ecological Survey. The checklist also applies these to Householder applications: the Heritage Assessment ('Full, Outline, Householder and Listed Building Consent'), the Green Belt Impact Statement ('Full, Outline and Householder'), the Materials Schedule (all applications involving extensions) and the Ecological survey, which covers roofspace works and demolition.
issues.evidence: 'HERITAGE ASSESSMENT Threshold – Requirement for Full, Outline, Householder and Listed Building Consent applications'

issues.detail: Non-material amendment is recorded as '(none)', but the checklist's NMA list includes the Accommodation Schedule, Accurate Visual Representations, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment, Equalities Statement and Façade Design Analysis. Reserved matters shows only the Crime Impact Statement, but its list also includes the Accommodation Schedule, AVRs, BNG, Context Character Appraisal, Daylight/Sunlight, Design Code Compliance Statement, Drainage Strategy, EIA, Equalities Statement and Façade Design Analysis. Advertisement consent, LDC, S73 / discharge of conditions and Works to trees are all '(none)', yet the checklist has a dedicated checklist for each, and the tree works and hedgerow checklists name items such as Tree Survey.
issues.evidence: Application Checklists section: separate checklists for Householder, Full, Outline, Reserved Matters, Non-Material Amendment, Discharge of Condition / S73, Listed Building Consent, Advertisement Consent, Lawful Development Certificates, Tree Works and Hedgerow Removal Notice

issues.detail:
About 35 rows are placed only under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named'. The checklist does name the application types, for example:
- Flood Risk Assessment: 'Full and outline'.
- Noise Assessment: 'Full and outline'.
- Open Space Assessment: 'Full and outline'.
- Health Impact Assessment: 'Full or outline'.
- M4(2)/M4(3) Compliance Statement: 'Full or outline'.
- Habitat Regulation Assessment: 'Full or outline'.
- Daylight and Sunlight: also Reserved Matters and NMA.
The reverse error also occurs. Affordable Housing, Air Quality, Drainage Strategy and Planning Statement are placed only under Outline, but the source says 'Full or Outline' / 'Full and Outline' for each. The CIL Question Form is under Outline and Householder but not Full.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'AFFORDABLE HOUSING STATEMENT Threshold – Requirement for Full or Outline planning applications...'; 'NOISE ASSESSMENT... Full and outline applications'

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment, Block plan / Site plan, and Existing and proposed site levels are placed under Listed building consent because their trigger excerpts contain the words 'Listed Buildings'. Those words come from the Heritage Assessment definition ('designated heritage assets include Scheduled Monuments, Listed Buildings...') inside a general criteria-based list, not from the LBC checklist. An FRA for sites of 0.5 ha+ in Critical Drainage Areas is a Full/Outline requirement, not an LBC one.
issues.evidence: LBC row trigger: 'Flood Risk Assessment – Where a site measures 0.5ha or more within Critical Drainage Areas... Green Belt Impact Statement – Where a site is within the green belt Heritage Assessment – required where...'

issues.detail:
Many trigger excerpts are fragments or are taken from the wrong requirement:
- 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes tree-protection method statement text.
- 'Ventilation / Extraction details' quotes bin-store text ('Size... Lighting and ventilation') running into the Wind Impact heading.
- 'Transport Assessment' and 'Travel Plan' both quote 'see guidance notes Tree Survey – required where there are trees...', which is the tree trigger.
- 'Pre-application advice' is AVR guidance.
- 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' is ALC/soils text, and Trafford's list has no agricultural workers' dwelling requirement.
- 'Cycle parking' and 'Parking provision' are just 'and motorcycle parking standards.'.
- 'Roof plan' is 'on the roof plan.'.
- 'Water efficiency' is quoted Core Strategy policy text.
- 'Flood Risk Assessment' under Full quotes the SuDS pro-forma guidance instead of the checklist thresholds (Flood Zones 2/3, 1 ha+ in FZ1, 0.5 ha+ in Critical Drainage Areas, Canal Hazard Zones).
issues.evidence: Checklist 'FLOOD RISK ASSESSMENT' threshold: Flood Zone 3 or 2, sites of 1ha or more in Flood Zone 1, 0.5ha or more in Critical Drainage Areas, Canal Hazard Zones

issues.detail:
Several tab_items are form fields, process text or fragments, not requirements:
- Items 7-16, filed under 'Drawing / document standards', are North West SuDS pro-forma form fields ('Please list any relevant document and or drawing numbers... S E C T I O N 2'; 'No ☐ Yes ☐').
- Item 0 is the 'common reasons applications are invalid' list from the guidance web page.
- Item 18 is process text ('will normally set out its reasons in writing... within 5-10 working days').
- Item 19 is a fragment of the Local Labour agreement content ('Work experience (14-16 years...').
- Item 23 is a garbled fragment ('Heat Trust 2 or equivalent). 1 the-uk-2020-pdf 2 HERITAGE ASSESSMENT...').

Several pairs repeat the same text:
- 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' and 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' share an identical trigger.
- 'Cycle parking details' and 'Parking provision' share an identical trigger.
- 'Transport Assessment' and 'Travel Plan' share an identical trigger.
- Tab items 7/8 (checklist Appendix 3) repeat items 9/10 (the separate SuDS pro-forma PDF).
- Tab items 24 and 25 both give the Habitat Regulation Assessment.
issues.evidence: identical trigger_excerpt strings in app_type_rows; tab_items 24-25

summary: Grokbot's link is to Trafford's current list, the Application Validation Checklist adopted January 2025; it works and the date is right. The extraction is poor. It misses about 15 local requirements, including the Green Belt Impact Statement, Design Code Compliance Statement, Façade Design Analysis, Accommodation Schedule, Materials Schedule, Digital Connectivity, Heat Network and Housing Needs. It ignores the checklist's per-application-type lists, so Householder, Reserved Matters, NMA and other types are largely empty. Many triggers come from the wrong section, and SuDS pro-forma form fields are listed as drawing standards.
